note: Diphtheria can cause breathing problems, heart failure, paralysis, and even death. Tetanus causes painful muscle stiffness and lockjaw. Pertussis (whooping cough) causes severe coughing fits that can lead to pneumonia, seizures, and brain damage.
title: Number of one-year-olds who are not fully vaccinated against diphtheria, pertussis and tetanus
subtitle: Number of one-year-olds who haven't received all three recommended doses of the [diphtheria](#dod:diphtheria), [pertussis](#dod:pertussis) and [tetanus](#dod:tetanus) vaccine (DTP). This includes children who have received one or two doses of the three dose course of the DTP vaccine.
